cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 shows the register covering taxpayers other than non-resident suppliers, or says the taxpayer number is shared with business registration or customs, or tied to the national ID.
cells.note: The tax directorate's online platform, in service since May 2026, registers non-resident suppliers and issues their tax numbers electronically under decree 2.25.862, so stage 3. Nothing on sharing the number with business registration or customs is held.
